worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for parallelization (-n flag).

use_soa_minttl.description: Use SOA MINTTL as default TTL for records without explicit TTL (-M flag).

verification_times.description: List of epoch times for signature verification (-t flag). Empty list uses current time.

policies.description: List of policy check names to activate (-p flag). Use 'all' for all standard checks.
